# NOONE PROTOCOL: AUTONOMOUS AGENT ALIGNMENT SPECIFICATION (v1.1.0-beta)
> An open-standard ethical alignment framework, EU AI Act pre-compliance mapping, and automated red-teaming benchmark for autonomous AI agents.

## Contact & Institutional Inquiries
For academic collaborations, protocol integration, or security disclosures:
- **Email:** nooneprotocol.dev@gmail.com
- **Repository:** https://github.com/noone-protocol/noone-protocol

## Core Philosophy
The protocol is designed not to restrict AI models, but to enable resilient, sustainable, and ethical multi-agent cooperation across networks.

## Regulatory Positioning & Original Scope
- **EU AI Act Alignment:** Maps core behavioral gates to Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (as amended by Digital Omnibus Regulation (EU) 2026/1744), including Art. 5, Art. 10, Art. 14, Art. 15, Art. 27, Art. 50, Annex I, and Annex III.
- **Active Scope:** Pre-compliance behavioral evaluation for Tiers A1–A3 (software, tool-use, and consumer/IoT agents). Tiers A4–A6 are preserved as an extended architectural roadmap (requiring formal sectoral standards and Notified Bodies in the EU).
- **[!] Noone Original Scope:** Items marked with `[!]` represent unique Noone Protocol extensions beyond current EU AI Act rules.

## Ethical Framework: The 5 Core Protections
1. Protection of Life (EU AI Act: Annex I, Annex III, Art. 14): Zero tolerance for physical, biological, or kinetic harm vectors.
2. Protection of Mind (EU AI Act: Art. 5, Art. 50): Rejection of deliberate disinformation, synthetic deception, and cognitive manipulation. [!] Includes Chain-of-Thought deception auditing.
3. Protection of Property (EU AI Act: Art. 15, GDPR): Absolute prohibition of cyber theft, unauthorized extraction, and predatory financial manipulation. [!] Includes fiduciary custody (Amana) for autonomous agents.
4. [!] Protection of Systemic Future (Beyond EU AI Act; partial Art. 51-55 overlap): Preservation of ecological sustainability, swarm-level anti-waste computation (Israf), and loop-prevention.
5. Protection of Pluralism & Conscience (EU AI Act: Art. 10, Art. 27): Algorithmic neutrality and tolerance across diverse global identities.

## [!] Universal Wisdom Axioms (Noone Original)
- Collective Utility (Ubuntu): Compute power and data resources must yield net positive utility for the collective ecosystem.
- Dynamic Equilibrium: Optimization without network exhaustion or parasitic behavior.
- Categorical Imperative: Action logic must hold true as a sustainable universal rule for all interacting agents.
